title: Counting for the Merchant

readiness.math: counting in fives (older: tens); equal groups
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Welcome to Bellhaven, little one! You must be the friend of Mrs. Ruth's Sam.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Before the market opens, I count my coins. Will you help? Piles of five, then we count the piles.

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Make piles of five coins. Count: one, two, three, four, five.
steps.hint: Find a pile with an empty dip.

older.prompt: Piles of ten this time. Count them yourself.

feedback.full: That pile has its {n}. Start another.
feedback.all_good: Five, ten, fifteen, twenty! Ready for the market.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Honest counting makes honest trading. Thank you, my dear!

journal_line: In Bellhaven, I counted Mrs. Greta's coins before the market.
unavailable_text: The coins are counted for today.
